subject: Hosted API activation & rateband clarification
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Nguyen <alexandra@finratio.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API activation & rateband clarification

Hi Alexandra — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a short list of asks so we can scope the hosted evaluation and get sandbox endpoints provisioned:

- What we showed: hosted API with streaming, per-endpoint rate limits, and automatic prefix/KV caching to reduce token costs.
- Proposed next steps: 1) provide sandbox staging & prod endpoints, 2) confirm target throughput profile (concurrency/peak bursts), 3) confirm region and any residency/VPC needs, 4) schedule a 30m ops preflight with engineering (ratebands + canary plan).

Operational details we need from you to size the hosted trial:
- Expected sustained concurrency (requests/sec) and expected peak bursts.
- Average tokens per request (input + expected generated tokens).
- Latency SLO target (p95) and any strict tail requirements.
- Any compliance constraints (EU data residency, SOC2 evidence, log retention windows).

From our side we can offer:
- Sandboxed staging endpoint (isolated tenant) and a production endpoint after a brief validation canary.
- Rateband slices: baseline allocation + configurable burst allowance (we can pre-warm a burst pool for the trial if you confirm burst sizing).
- Prefix and KV caching enabled by default for chat-like flows — we’ll provide a short guide on cache key strategy.

I attached a short onboarding checklist (redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf) and a SOC2 summary pointer. If you can reply with the traffic profile and residency needs by EOD Wednesday we’ll aim to have sandbox credentials and a proposed canary plan for Thursday.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf (1 page)
---
From: Alexandra Nguyen <alexandra@finratio.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API activation & rateband clarification

Thanks Evelyn — appreciate the clear list. A few answers and questions from our side: 

- Sustained concurrency: ~40 requests/sec on weekday business hours.
- Peak bursts: up to ~120 requests/sec during batch jobs and campaign spikes (10-15 minute windows).
- Average tokens per request: ~450 tokens (prompt + expected model output).
- Latency target: p95 < 150ms, p99 < 350ms ideally.
- Residency: data for EU customers must stay within EU for logs and request/responses.

Questions: 
1) Can you confirm whether the sandbox endpoints will be in eu-west-1 for the trial?
2) Is burst capacity enforced as a hard throttle or a soft burst pool (we prefer soft burst with queued requests rather than hard reject).
3) Do you provide sample traffic templates (curl/sdk) for the canary ramp so our SREs can replicate?
4) Procurement: we have a standard PO process — typical turnaround there is 2–3 weeks after DocuSign. Do you accept PO + perimeter security questionnaire?

If you can send the sandbox details and a proposed canary (we can do 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24–48h if that works) we’ll schedule the ops call.

Best,
Alexandra Nguyen
Head of Integrations, FinRatio
alexandra@finratio.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Nguyen <alexandra@finratio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-20T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API activation & rateband clarification

Alexandra — great details, thanks. Looping in Karthik (runtime/ops) and Rishi (solutions engineering) to cover the technical pieces below and to join the ops preflight. Answers inline and action items at the bottom.

1) EU sandbox: yes — we can provision the sandbox endpoints in eu-west-1 for the trial. We’ll spin up isolated tenant endpoints (staging) and provide a production-looking endpoint after the canary pass.

2) Burst behavior: we support configurable burst pools. For the initial trial we recommend a soft-burst configuration: baseline rateband with a pre-warmed burst pool that absorbs short spikes and then throttles to a controlled queue/slowdown rather than immediate 429s. We can tune the pool size to your 120 rps peak. Karthik can confirm memory/kv-cache sizing for that.

3) Traffic templates: yes — attaching a short curl/sdk template and a canary ramp playbook. We’ll include a sample 5% -> 25% -> 100% ramp script and recommended observation windows (15m windows at each step).

4) Procurement: we accept PO + DocuSign for baseline commitments. The SOC2 summary link is below; for full questionnaires we can schedule a security sync with our compliance team.

Action items:
- Rishi: can you prepare a 20–30m canary script (curl + node SDK) and a short runbook we can hand to FinRatio SREs? (target: tomorrow EOD)
- Karthik: validate the soft-burst pool settings to safely support 120rps short spikes for EU sandbox and estimate any warmup time.
- Evelyn: send sandbox credentials + onboarding checklist and confirm a 30m ops call slot.

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf, soc2-summary-link.txt, docusign-PO-template.pdf

Proposed ops windows (PST): Thu 09/23 08:00–08:30 or Thu 09/23 16:00–16:30 — which works for you?

Thanks — we’ll aim to have the sandbox ready as soon as we confirm the window.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs:
- redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf (1 page)
- soc2-summary-link.txt (contains: https://drive.google.com/finratio-soc2-evidence)

From: Alexandra Nguyen <alexandra@finratio.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API activation & rateband clarification

Thanks — Thu 09/23 16:00–16:30 PST works for our SRE and procurement lead. Please send the sandbox creds and the canary script when ready; we’ll aim to sign the PO template quickly (our legal needs to review, procurement estimates 10 business days).

A couple quick notes:
- We’ll use the 5% -> 25% -> 100% ramp (24h total) unless the canary script suggests otherwise.
- For the EU residency requirement: we’ll want logs and request traces retained in eu-west-1 for the duration of the trial — happy to review your SOC2 evidence in the sync.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Alexandra
Head of Integrations, FinRatio
alexandra@finratio.com
